equipment_type: Energy meter (Ethernet energy monitoring / data logger)
applies_to: TCW260 per the Teracom TCW260 user manual Revision R1.19, firmware V3.009 or later.
summary: The TCW260 is a Teracom Ethernet energy monitoring and logging module with 4 S0-capable digital inputs, 6 analog inputs (voltage or current-loop mode) and an RS-485 Modbus RTU master for up to 24 sensors. It builds up to 24 calculated channels with alarms, all of which are exposed over Modbus TCP.

addressing.note: The address table prints PDU (wire) addresses in decimal. The manual's example frames use them directly (holding register 19300 = 0x4B64, discrete input 100 = 0x0064), so no offset is applied.

source.title: TCW260 User manual
source.pages: section 9.3 main table and Appendix C (full Modbus TCP/IP register list)

notes: Word order: the manual says float registers are sent big-endian and its example response 41DD 4210 is given as 27.657, i.e. high word first (ABCD).
Strings are fixed-length UTF-8, zero padded; a 16-byte field spans 8 registers.
Registers come from the main address table and the full list in Appendix C; where both list an address it appears once.
Left out: the rows for analog input 6 multiplier and offset, which the manual prints at the same addresses as input 1 (14100, 14200), an apparent typo.

Left out: the 64 32-bit unsigned integer registers (Channel counter; Digital input close to open delay; Digital input counter init value; Digital input counter value; Digital input open to close delay; MB sensor counter). The manual states big-endian order only for floats and strings, so their word order is not documented.

integration.summary: Enable Modbus TCP, then read the 24 channel results as floats from holding registers 19300-19347 and the alarm states from 22000-22023 with function 03.
integration.enable: Modbus TCP/IP is disabled by default. Enable it in the Modbus TCP/IP section of the web setup (standard port 502).
quirks: Settings changed over Modbus are stored by writing 1 to Save configuration (PDU 24000), as the manual notes above its address table.
setup: The factory IP is 192.168.1.2; change it in the network settings, then enable Modbus TCP/IP.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
